nom: Origins Checks and Balances Gentle Foaming Face Wash

avis.titre: I would recommend this product to everyone.
avis.texte: When I got home from shopping at Ultra in my bag was a sample of this. This product was amazing so creamy and the lovely minty smell. I had my husband try it and he was hock too. Great product.
I thought this product worked very well. My face felt very clean and refreshed after using. Many washes are hard on my skin but I had no issues.

I really liked this. I used this as part two of my usual two part face wash routine as my wash after a micellar water cleanse. It got the bits of makeup the micellar water missed and left my face feeling squeaky clean. And most importantly it didn't cause any skin irritation or weirdness, as most new products do for my very finicky skin. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Received a Sample but now a Buyer
avis.texte: This fade wash honestly surprised me in the best way. The foam feels super soft and gentle, but it still leaves my face feeling really clean without that tight, dry feeling afterward. After using it for a little while, I noticed my skin looked calmer, smoother, and way less dull. My redness didn't seem as angry, and my face actually felt hydrated instead of irritated. A little bit goes a long way too, so the bottle lasts longer than I expected. The smell is light and fresh without being overpowering, and my skin just looks healthier overall when I use it consistently. I use it in the morning and at night. It is definitely one of the few face washes I've tried that makes my skin feel balanced instead of stripped. I'll absolutely buy this one after my sample runs out. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I did like this face wash. I used it in place of my usual one in the shower & it did lather up nicely & rinse off nicely. Left face feeling clean & still soft not tight or shiny. Only thing I did not like was the scent. I was hoping would smell like the toner. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Good addition to night time routine
avis.texte: I've been using the Origins Checks and Balances™ Gentle Foaming Face Wash mostly at night, and it feels really gentle on my skin. It lathers into a light foam, cleans well, and doesn't leave my face feeling tight or dry. My skin feels soft and balanced after rinsing, and the subtle scent is add on. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
I loved this product when I tried it it left my face so fresh and clean feeling. It was very lightweight very gentle to my skin but the after almost had a glowing look. A definite yes!

This ended up being perfect for my skin. I didn't find it drying at all. All it needs is a good moisturizer afterwards are as a does. It had a lovey, light refreshing scent and it foamed up really well. It had a great silly texture going on and really cleaned my skin. Perfect for end of day as I used it for. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
Excellent high quality foaming face wash, I received from Topbox Circle box. I would buy this product on my own once I finish the tester.

avis.titre: Would definitely recommend for those with sensitive skin!
avis.texte: The Origins Checks and Balances Gentle Foaming Cleanser is pretty much the softer side of the original Checks and Balances Cleanser. It's an excellent option for those with sensitive skin, as it's un-fragranced and creamier than the original version. It's both effective at cleansing and removing makeup, yet doesn't strip the skin of essential moisture. You won't get the froth youre accustomed to with the original version, but it does work effectively. I would highly recommend! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes, and found myself to be pleasantly surprised! This face wash is very gentle, and easy to use, but yet it's very powerful. It's great for if you're someone who deals with pores and dead skin. I will definitely be purchasing in the future!
I use this at night and my face feels so soft and smooth after using! "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

My initial impression was that the product was thin and quite runny. I used it in the shower, in place of my usual face cleanser. This product ran through my fingers, it ran off my facial scrubber. However, despite the consistency it did foam up, pretty decently and it left my skin feeling clean. Was very gentle. *I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I got this as a sample and honestly this is such a good product, it left my face feeling so light and clean. The texture and foaming was perfect for a full face wash, I would definitely recommend to someone with combination skin

avis.titre: Gentle Foaming Wash is one of my fav's!!!
avis.texte: I buy this face wash all the time and I have dry sensitive fair skin. My skin still feels the slightest bit dry after washing with this but it takes off my makeup so well that I don't care. I just put on a good moisturizer afterwards. I use it nightly to get my face really clean. I will always continue to buy this! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

"I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. Not only does it smell amazing, but it made my skin feel so soft and clean! If you haven't tried this yet you need to! It makes my skin look and feel amazing all day long, plus its not harsh on your face.

avis.titre: A clean, balanced-feeling cleanser with a fresh minty vibe
avis.texte: Origins Checks and Balances is one of those cleansers that feels instantly refreshing without being harsh. It starts as a creamy gel and turns into a rich, fluffy foam that cleans well but doesn't strip your skin. The scent is a light minty‑herbal vibe, energizing but not overpowering. It removes sunscreen and oil easily, leaves combo skin feeling balanced, and keeps everything looking smooth and steady. Not a treatment cleanser, just a reliable, gentle daily wash that makes your face feel fresh and comfortable. Over time, it keeps the skin looking steady and clear not dramatically different, but consistently fresh and smooth. It's not meant to treat anything specific like acne or texture, but it's a reliable everyday cleanser that keeps your skin in a good place.

This wash is genuinely so good! Its so gentle on skin ive been using since! Its smells nice but soft too so you can definitely use even if sensitive! This product was sent to me for review and absolutely loved!

I honestly saw no difference in improvement over time. I have an oily skin surface so I do think that played a factor. If there are any products that are able to address this concern and reach deep into my skins surface, that would be most helpful.

I have combination/sensitive skin so I'm always a little nervous to try new things. I received this as a sample and LOVED IT! Worked well with my skin. Highly recommend! "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I'm glad I received this product to test out, it was shocking how impressed I was by this cleanser. It was gentle enough to not annoy my sensitive roseaca skin. The texture of this cleanser happens to smooth but textured. It cleans my face and leaves it feeling hydrated

avis.titre: It's a check & balances for sure
avis.texte: As someone whom has roseaca and sensitive skin, I was shocked at how much my face did not react to this cleanser. The texture was actually perfect in my opinion its a slightly smooth but textured.

avis.titre: Gentle, Hydrating Cleanser That Actually Made a Difference
avis.texte: I tried the Origins Checks and Balances Gentle Foaming Face Wash while traveling and used it mainly in the morning. It left my skin feeling fresh, clean, and hydrated. The foam is light and gentle, but still really effective. My face still felt hydrated at the end of the day. When I got home and switched back to my usual cleanser, my skin actually felt drier. That's when I added this into my routine for the past week, and I've definitely noticed a difference—my skin feels smoother, moisturized and more balanced overall. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Light scent, gentle, but a little drying
avis.texte: I like the Check and Balances face wash. The scent is very light, if any, so it isn't overpowering. It doesn't exactly "lather", per se, but my skin felt very clean afterwards. I feel like this is a nice, gentle face wash that can be used daily. I did feel like my skin was somewhat dry afterwards, so I did need to lather on some moisturized. However, this may be attributed to the harsh midwestern winter. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

A basic face wash that meets your daily needs. It cleanses deep and removes all makeup and pollution, which I need! Makes my skin feel squeaky clean and has the best ingredients. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes

avis.titre: Checks And Balances—Gentile Foaming Face Wash
avis.texte: I've been using the Checks and Balances™ Gentle Foaming Face Wash mostly at night, and it's quickly become one of my favorite gentle cleansers. The texture starts as a cream and transforms into a light, airy foam that feels really soft on my skin. I have dry, sensitive skin, so I'm always cautious with face washes, but this one didn't leave my skin feeling tight or stripped at all. Instead, my face felt clean, balanced, and noticeably softer after each use. I also appreciated the subtle, fresh scent—it's not overpowering, just clean and calming. The blend of ingredients like amino acid cleansers and sunflower seed oil seems to really help maintain hydration while still effectively removing the day's buildup. Overall, it's a great option if you're looking for a gentle but effective daily cleanser. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
I absolutely love this cleanser! It's the perfect base to your skin routine. Great to use for daytime or nighttime use.

avis.titre: I was not impressed with this one
avis.texte: I was sent this product in exchange for an honest review so here it is....The product didn't foam right and the texture really threw me off. It smells organic and earthy but really dried out my face. I wouldn't purchase this if you have dry skin or combination skin

The product is very good, with good texture, it remove the makeup and dirty from my face, and i didn't have any allergic reaction, i have a sensitive skin so i really recommend the product. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes

The frothy texture, gentle massageability, and refined scent elevate cleansing into a truly luxurious experience. Light yet effective, it glides easily across skin, rinses clean without residue, and leaves the complexion feeling refreshed, soft, and comfortable, with no heaviness or lingering film. Perfect for daily use on all skin types.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again !
avis.texte: So checks and balances did they thing with this gentle foaming face wash. It leaves your skin feeling refreshed and smooth. I enjoyed that it did not leave my face feeling dry but left it feeling very moisturized and refreshed. I give it a 10 out of 10 and would recommend it.

I used Checks and Balances every morning and night. It didn't leave my skin feeling taught but it did feel oil free. It does foam well and it did not irritate my skin. It is truly unscented, and a little goes a long way. I did use it with Origins facial brush. The biggest negative is it doesn't really remove make up. I don't wear a ton of makeup, so that's not the issue. I find I have to use my micellar water to remove my makeup and then wash Checks and Balances. "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

This face wash has a really nice velvety feel. A little bit goes a long way and it foams up really nice while still feeling like butter at the same time, however, it is not greasy at all. It rinsed off well without leaving my skin feeling slimy or dry. There is zero sting to to the eyes whish. Is the best!! I would definitely consider buying this in the future. "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes"
Can't say enough about this producta If you want your face to feel clean and fresh, this is the choice! I could tell when I ran out because my face began to get oily again. Must purchase!

I received this product as part of a promotion. Love how this product massages in to the skin. Feels very gentle and not stripping. Washes completely clean with no residue or film feel after. Great product!

I've been using this at night and it leaves my skin clean without that tight, dry feeling. I like that it has glycerin and gentler cleansing ingredients, which makes it feel balanced on my skin. The texture is smooth, the scent is light, and it's been easy to use even on sensitive days. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

So, this is a very unique product in my opinion but I really liked it. It did not foam/suds up for me like standard face washes but instead had a very (nice) creamy texture. It almost felt like the consistency of moisturizer going on. Based on this I wasn't expecting a very clean face but it actually surpassed my expectations. I used it in the morning and my face really felt clean without drying my skin out to produce the "tight" feeling. My skin felt really smooth annd clean after rinsing. I only rated four stars because it claims it's foaming but I don't get a lot of foam. Overall, will purchase again full size. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Nice cleanser, would buy it again
avis.texte: Got this cleanser. It looks like milky from the looks of it , but turns into nice foam. It doesnt have a fragrance which is what i always look for. Just one small amount of it goes a long way. Skin feels clean, hydrated and plump. Would buy it again.

avis.titre: Refreshing Nighttime Cleanser: A Perfect Second Step!
avis.texte: I recently tried the product from Origins, and I really enjoyed the experience! I used it at night after removing my makeup, and it felt like a wonderful second step in my double cleansing routine. The texture was smooth, and it effectively helped remove any leftover impurities, leaving my skin feeling incredibly clean. Although it didn't have much of a scent, the subtle fragrance was pleasant and not overpowering, which I appreciated. Overall, my skin felt refreshed and well-cared for after using it. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

Used this product at night after a shower, just to get rid of any grime or residue from the day. Left my face feeling clean but not dry, I loved it! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I wash my face with this product that I received free to try it left me feeling refreshed and ready for the day. I used it when I woke up in the morning an it left my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. Again, I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this face wash consistently for a few weeks now, and overall, it does exactly what I need it to do. It cleans my skin well without leaving it feeling tight or stripped, which is something I'm pretty particular about. The texture is smooth and easy to work into a lather, and a small amount goes a long way. After rinsing, my skin feels fresh and looks noticeably clearer, especially around areas where I tend to get clogged pores. I also appreciate that it doesn't have an overpowering scent—it's light and not irritating. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
This is an awesome product. Using this with the face wash is a great duo to wash and tone your face. Will recommend to all my friends and family.
Loved this product! I can't wait to purchase! Honestly the best product I have used and left my face nice and fresh.
Received in exchange for honest review. It's light, nicely scented, easy to use, and very sudsy! Leaves my skin feeling clean and airy. I'd definitely buy a bigger size of this!!
Excellent product. Cleans skin without leaving a residue, redness or dry itchy skin.

This cleanser has a great texture, creamy and substantial without feeling heavy. It's very faintly scented with a nice clean finish. I've used both as a second step in my double cleanse and on its own if I'm in a rush, and it leaves my face clean and moisturized without feeling stripped. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

Origins Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash is a solid everyday cleanser that leaves skin feeling fresh without stripping it dry. The minty, slightly tingly sensation makes it especially refreshing in the morning, and it does a great job balancing oily and dry areas. It's a reliable pick if you want clean, comfortable skin without that tight, over-cleansed feeling.

I received a small free sample of Origins Checks and Balances gentle foaming face wash and incorporated it into my nighttime cleansing routine. It does not produce excessive suds but does produces a clean finish. My skin, which is extremely sensitive and tends to flare up when I introduce new products, has been clear. The cleanser is also fragrance free so that is a plus for me as well. I will likely purchase this item in the future and recommend it to those who want a clean feel without using a product that is overly foamy or fragrant. If you are someone who likes your cleanser to produce a good foam to feel clean, this may not be the product for you. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I really wanted to love this. The description sounded like it would be great for my skin. Unfortunately, it broke me out and really clogged my pores. Would maybe be better for super dry skin. It felt like it left a film and didn't truly cleanse. Also, this brand usually has a wonderful signature white ginger and tea scent but this did not.

avis.titre: Gent;le, effective and perfect for daily use.
avis.texte: Since starting perimenopause, my skin has been unpredictable, but the Origins Checks & Balances Gentle Foaming Face Wash has been a total game-changer. I use it both morning and night, and I love how smoothly it applies. The foaming effect is incredibly gentle yet effective, leaving my face feeling thoroughly clean without any tightness. What impressed me most is how it handles my dry patches around my nose and chin; instead of stripping them, it actually helped calm and hydrate those areas. I haven't experienced any breakouts or irritation since I started using it. It's a fantastic, reliable cleanser for anyone dealing with hormonal skin changes. "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

avis.titre: Checks and balances, gentle, foaming face wash.
avis.texte: I tried this cleanser in the morning and before bed. It lathers up with some scrubbing and you can feel how clean your skin is after using it. My face did not feel dry after. The smell is very neutral. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
This is so amazing I love how it has my face feeling so hydrated I recommend this 💜

I have been using my origins checks and balances gentle foaming face wash for a little over two weeks so far. I absolutely love it. I use it just at night before bed. It leaves my face feeling so smooth. No greasy or oily feeling and it has no fragrance which is nice for sensitive skin. I wake up to my face feeling nice and refreshed. A little drop of product also goes a long way. I'd have to say hands down this is the best face wash I have tried as of yet. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. Thank you Origins for this amazing face wash!

avis.titre: Lathers well with just a small amount.
avis.texte: It doesn't take much of the product to get a lather. It cleans pretty decent. However, I'm not crazy about the scent of it. I can't really describe it, but it's not a very pleasant smell. I probably would not purchase. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

[I received a sample of this free for testing purposes] Okay fave wash. Nothing special. It didn't make my skin feel dry and didn't cause any irritation so it would be perfect for someone with sensitive skin. I just don't feel like it cleaned my face good and my pores still looked a little dirty after use.

avis.titre: This product effectively revitalizes the skin, leaving it fe
avis.texte: I have been utilizing the Checks and Balances foaming face wash nightly for the past two weeks. I have not observed any notable alterations in my skin's condition. As an individual with sensitive skin, I can confirm that this product did not induce any irritation. The fragrance is exceptionally subtle, almost imperceptible. It lathers effectively, leaving the skin feeling thoroughly cleansed and refreshed. Overall, this product delivers a very agreeable experience. I received this product complimentary from Origins for evaluation and review purposes.

I love this wash. It's simple enough to use on a daily basis but it still helps my skin feel refreshed and clean. I've always loved origins products so I am glad I can add another of their products to my skincare regimen. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
Is very simpke to use, and your skin feel soft after the firts use. No harm to the skin and very gentle.

avis.titre: An excellent product for lovers of unperfumed products
avis.texte: Overall, it's a great product; my skin feels clean and fresh afterward! It's fragrance-free and creamy. I wish it lathered a little better, but it doesn't produce much. "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

I received a free sample of CHECKS AND BALANCE Gentle Foaming Face Wash from Top box circle and didn't really think it would work as good as I was expecting but I loved it I used it every night before I went to bed worth trying
My face was nice and soft after using this face wash- not dry at all! I'm super pleased with the results.

This skin wash really works! It cleans your face and skin without leaving any residue. My face felt so clean and fresh even after the first use. It is a great product for your face care. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I use this cleanser in the morning and evening. I love how well it lathers up and you can feel how clean your skin is after using it. My face doesn't feel dry at all after using it like with some cleansers. Highly recommend. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This foaming cleanser was so good, i tried it both in the morning and at night, super smooth, soapy and gentle, got in my eye and it wasn't irritated, would definitely recommend it! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

Love this face wash. It was foamy and cleaned my face without leaving it dry and itchy.thoroughly removed all my makeup and left my skin feeling supple and hydrated. Didn't love the smell but still worth buying and adding to my daily routine. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

avis.titre: Is Origins Face Wash Worth It? My Honest Thoughts
avis.texte: I've been using the Origins Checks and Balances Face Wash, and I really like how it makes my skin feel. It cleans my face deeply but still feels gentle, like it's helping my skin stay balanced without stripping it. After I use it, my skin feels fresh, soft, and really clean. I also love that it gives me a little moment of self-care and peace in my day. Taking care of the skin God gave me is something I've been learning to do with more intention. Overall, I really recommend it, especially if you have combination skin.

This face wash is super gentle but still cleans really well. It doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or tight, and my face feels soft and hydrated after using it. It also removes makeup better than I expected. I have somewhat sensitive skin and didn't have any irritation or breakouts. Definitely something I'd use daily and would repurchase.
I received a sample and absolutely loved it! I have also recommended it to several friends as it left my skin nice and smooth.

I've never tried Origins products before and my introduction with this cleanser didn't disappoint. It's milky running texture that foams easily and cleanses the skin without stripping the oils away. Great as a morning cleanse, may need double wash in the evening. Doesn't have any smell which is great for sensitive skin. I received this product from the Origins for testing purposes.

This is such a nice and gentle face wash. I love to use it both to refresh my skin in the morning and as a first step of my nighttime skincare routine. It's very gentle and does not irritate my extremely sensitive skin. I really enjoy using it. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I used this face was every morning and it always left my skin feeling fresh and clean. However, I didn't notice any changes in how clear my skin was, or any help with breakouts. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser is gentle and foaming, so it goes on smoothly. I have combination skin and this felt way too drying. It gave my skin a tight squeaky clean feel that made me feel more dehydrated once I was done. I would only recommend this if you have extremely oily skin. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been using this cleanser for close to 2 weeks now for my evening cleanse and I really enjoy it. It has virtually no scent and I know that's important for many people. It got my skin very clean but didn't strip it at all, which is important because I use tretinoin and do peels and microneedling. It left my skin feeling very smooth. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I typically use this product in the evening to remove my makeup. I have been impressed with the gentleness of the product on my sensitive skin. The foaming action helps to get a deep clean feeling and I have experienced no breakouts from this product. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser feels soo good going on, the lather and creaminess is peak luxury but I will say it does leave my skin feeling dry and tight immediately upon rinsing. That being said the clean feels deep and there is no scent so it feels like true skin care.

Its an amazing face wash that you can feel your skin getting proper treatment as its fresh and clean to the touch and it has the scent of freshness. Will be buying this product as it benefit my skin from it.

avis.titre: Good Clean, but Drying in Some Areas
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for testing and review. I've been using it for a week, both morning and night. It leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh after each use, which I really like. It also does a good job of removing most of my makeup. However, I've noticed that it tends to dry out the areas around my mouth and nose. Additionally, while it removes face makeup well, it doesn't fully remove eyeliner and mascara. Overall, it's a decent product for everyday cleansing, but it may not be the best option if you have dry or sensitive areas or if you're looking to remove heavy eye makeup.

I used this product at night when I showed. Half of the time I would double cleanse before using this product. This face was foams nicely especially after using an oil cleanser. The ingredients say it has spearmint leaf oil, which I love , but I did not notice any cooling feeling or scent. Which is really no biggy to me though. All in all its a good product and gets the job done!
I love this face wash so much! It is very gentle on your face. It does not leave your skin feeling dry. My skin feels so soft and hydrated after using it. It cleans off your makeup really well!

This foaming wash smells really good and is gentle on your skin. I have sensitive skin and this didn't make me break out. It also smells great and is easy to use. Would buy again in the future. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
Honestly I thought this was gonna make me break out but thankfully it didn't. The foaming wash smells great and creates lots of foam. Was gentle on my skin and not too abrasive.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I've been testing this Origins face wash for about a week now and it seems they know what they're doing. It foams nicely, doesn't feel gel-like or gloopy, and so far I have had no flares or redness. This wash is also nicely hydrating, as I've noticed areas on my face that would normally have small dry patches are gone. The scent is very light and clean, which I enjoy as it doesn't linger while in use. Would highly recommend this Origins face wash for those with sensitive skin looking for a simple yet effective face wash.
Gentle enough for daily use and luxurious at the same time. Skin feels soft, smooth, and refreshed after every wash.

It lathered nicely, no scent, and kept the oil on my nose in check. For someone with a combo skin type that's a huge plus! Used this face wash both morning and at night, leaving my skin feeling super clean and fresh without that tight dry vibe I sometimes get with other face washes. Definitely feels like a little treat for myself when I'm doing my skin care routine. I should also mention I received this product for free from origins for testing and review purposes.

As someone with sensitive skin & super dry, I was highly impressed with this Origins Face Wash. It goes on so smooth, not too foamy, no sticky after residue or strong smell. It left my face feeling so refreshed, clean and hydrated. Didn't leave my face feeling dried out & my skin feeling tight like some do. I use this every night before bed to cleanse my face and a little bit goes along way. I have found my new go to face wash for squeaky clean and feeling refreshed. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes and have been using this product for a week both morning and night now and I am impressed. It leaves my skin feeling cleansed and hydrated but not greasy. I use several other products and it leaves the perfect canvas for layering those on. I would give it a 9/10 compared to other cleansers I've tried.

avis.titre: Works great for combination to sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I've been using this every night for almost three weeks, and my skin hasn't had any irritation or dry patches. I really appreciate how gentle it is and doesn't strip my skin of moisture; it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight after every wash (which I find great!). A little goes a long way! Plus, the fine foams it creates make my skin feel soft, and it hasn't triggered my eczema on the sides of my nose. I love that it has no scent and doesn't leave sticky residue. I would recommend this product if your skin is compromised, you have active skin irritation, or oily skin in the t-zone like me. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the Origins foaming cleanser in both my morning and nighttime routine, and it's quickly become a favorite. The cleanser lathers really nicely with just a small amount, creating a soft foam that feels gentle yet effective on the skin. It does a great job of removing dirt, oil, and leftover makeup without leaving my face feeling stripped or dry. One of my favorite things about this cleanser is how fresh and clean my skin feels after each use. The texture is light and smooth, and I really enjoyed the subtle, refreshing scent it makes the whole experience feel a bit more luxurious. After rinsing, my skin feels balanced, soft, and prepped perfectly for the rest of my skincare routine. I also appreciate that it didn't cause any irritation or breakouts, which is always a concern when trying new products. Overall, it's a gentle yet effective cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and comfortable. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed this face wash! It has a light, clean scent that feels fresh without being overpowering. The texture is creamy and smooth, making it feel gentle yet effective on the skin. With a double cleanse, it removed all of my makeup effortlessly and didn't cause any irritation. My skin felt soft, clean, and refreshed after each use. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I used this moisturizer at night after an oil cleanse. It foamed up nicely, and still felt rich and moisturizing. It didn't strip my skin and it was very gentle. I really liked this product. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I have mixed/oily skin and used it at night after I had some concealer and blush on during the day, it foams a bit but after finishing rinsing my face I felt like my skin still needed a bit more cleansing, this product is aimed at dry/normal skin so maybe that's why

I tried the Origins Checks & Balances Gentle Foaming Face Wash, using it both morning and night. Overall, it performed well as a consistent, everyday cleanser. The texture is smooth and creates a light foam that feels gentle on the skin without being overly stripping. One thing I appreciated was that there really wasn't much of a noticeable scent, which I personally prefer in skincare products. It made the experience feel simple and non-irritating. After regular use, my skin felt clean and balanced, without any tightness. While it may not stand out as a standout or transformative product, it's a solid, reliable option for those looking for a gentle, no-frills face wash.

If you're looking for a cleanser that leaves your skin feeling silky and balanced, this is definitely a 10/10 for me!

I like to doube cleanse, so I use a cleansing oil first, and then a foaming cleanser. As a combo, this left my skin squeaky clean. Also, a little bit goes a long way. avis.titre: Checks & Balances Gears Me Up for My Day!
avis.texte: I'm always running behind but I don't play with my skincare! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes, and honestly I'm not sure why I haven't tried it before. From the minty fresh scent to the frothy lather that erupts when massaging it on my face with warm water, it's a game changer for me and I love how silky smooth it makes my face feel after rinsing. I use this in the am after my face scrub and at night after removing my makeup to ensure my face is prepped and ready for the various treatments and moisturizers I use. avis.titre: I'm squeaky clean… in a good way!

After massaging it into my face and neck and rinsing it off, my skin feels squeaky clean but still moisturized and ready for my day ahead. In the evening, I use checks and balances after removing my makeup with a balm to ensure that I have all of the balm off and all of my makeup off. This is a product that I didn't realize was available until given the tester to try - I have now put this on subscription and will be getting it every other month so that I never run out and stay minty fresh and squeaky clean!

I used Checks & Balances at night, before bed & after using my micellar water. I used a dime size amnt., rubbing between my finger tips. It made a soft foam that I applied, in light circles, with my fingers, to my face & neck. Then splashed water on my face to rinse & I patted dry. I've used similar cleansers for as long as I can remember & 1 thing that I've noticed with most all, if not all... Is the scent or rather the smell, glue! I'm always reminded of school glue. Check & Balances was no different in that category but where I feel the cleanser was different... Is how my skin was not immediately thirsty, drying up, tight(not in a good way) & itchy within 2mins. I didn't have to hurry to apply the next steps in my skin care routine. I could take my time a lil & I wasn't in any discomfort! I'm almost 50yrs old & my skin is not at all what it used to be in my 30's. At about 41yrs old my skin turned on me. I really had very good skin. No texture, really or black heads. I'd not ever had acne, at all, ever. Nor had I wrinkles or lose skin that was obvious. 41 hit & my skins never been the same. I'd dread washing my face because of the irritation & discomfort it would often bring. These last 2wks that I've been using Checks & Balances... My skin isn't so angry & isn't so cracked looking, if that's even a description! I've been using Origins products since I was 15, when the products first came out & I really like how friendly every product is as well as how friendly the employee
